spans.s:
m. (-णः)
A cutter of bambus, a worker in bambu work.
E.
वेणु a bambu, अण् aff., and the primitive final rejected.

mfn. (-वः-वी-वं)
Produced by or made of a bambu.
m. (-वः)
1 A bambu staff in general.
2 A worker in bambu or wickerwork.
E.
वेणु a bambu, and अण् aff.

m. (-कः)
A player on a flute.
E.
वेणु a pipe, ठक् aff.

m. (-कः)
A lutist, a player on the Vīṇā or Indian lute.
E.
वीणा the Vīṇā, and ठक् aff.

n. (-कं)
A goad or bambu pike headed with iron, used to drive an elephant.
m. (-कः)
A player on a pipe or flute.
E.
वेणु a flute, कञ् aff.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Relating or belonging to a bambu, &c.
E.
वेणु a bambu, and छण् aff., with कुक् augment.

m. (-ण्यः)
A name of PṚTHU, the fifth sovereign of the solar race.
E.
वेण the father of this monarch, and यञ् aff.; also read वैन्य.
